name: SpecFit | Try & Shop – AI Virtual Try-On for WooCommerce
author: dugudlabs

sections.description:
Bring the future of eyewear shopping to your WooCommerce store with SpecFit | Try & Shop, an AI-powered virtual try-on plugin designed specifically for eyewear businesses.

SpecFit enables customers to virtually try eyeglasses, sunglasses, and optical frames directly from WooCommerce product pages using mobile cameras or desktop webcams.

The entire virtual try-on technology, AI processing, product rendering, and 3D pipeline are powered by TrynShop.

More details about the platform:
https://trynshop.com/

Whether you run:

  • An online eyewear store
  • A sunglasses brand
  • An optical showroom
  • A physical retail eyewear store

SpecFit helps customers visualize products before purchasing and creates a more engaging shopping experience.

Powered by TrynShop Technology

SpecFit uses TrynShop’s cloud-powered AI virtual try-on platform for:

  • AI face tracking
  • 2D virtual try-on
  • 3D virtual try-on
  • Eyewear alignment
  • Product processing
  • Cloud synchronization
  • Store management
  • Virtual rendering optimization

Learn more about the technology:
https://trynshop.com/

Live Demos

TrynShop Demo Store

https://trynshop.com/shop/dugudlabs

WooCommerce Demo Store

https://dugudlabs.com/specfit-demo-shop/

Platform Details

https://trynshop.com/

Why Use SpecFit?

Online eyewear shopping often creates uncertainty:

  • Will these glasses fit me?
  • Will this frame suit my face?
  • How will these frames look in real life?

SpecFit removes that friction using real-time AI virtual try-on technology powered by TrynShop.

Benefits include:

  • Increased conversions
  • Better customer engagement
  • Reduced returns
  • Higher customer confidence
  • Interactive product pages
  • Modern shopping experience

Free Plan Included

SpecFit includes an Always Free plan.

Free plan features:

  • Up to 50 Products
  • 2D Virtual Try-On
  • WooCommerce Integration
  • Cloud Dashboard Access
  • AI Face Detection
  • Mobile & Desktop Support

Perfect for small stores and businesses getting started with virtual try-on.

Premium Features

  • AI-Powered Virtual Try-On
  • Realistic 3D Eyewear Experience
  • Automatic Face Detection
  • Live Try-On via Webcam or Mobile Camera
  • Smart Frame Recommendations
  • Mobile Friendly Design
  • WooCommerce Product Sync
  • Cloud-Based Product Management
  • Multiple Try-On Images
  • Optimized Virtual Try-On Rendering
  • Built for Online & Physical Stores
  • In-Store Virtual Try-On Support
  • High Performance & Fast Loading
  • Easy Store Setup
  • TrynShop Cloud Processing
  • Automatic Asset Optimization

Built for Physical Optical Stores

SpecFit is not limited to online stores.

The plugin and TrynShop platform can also be used for:

  • Optical stores
  • Smart mirrors
  • In-store kiosks
  • Tablet-assisted sales
  • Retail try-on experiences
  • Eyewear showrooms

Offer customers a modern digital shopping experience directly inside your physical store.

How It Works

Step 1 — Install the Plugin

Install and activate the plugin from your WordPress dashboard.

Step 2 — Create Your Store on TrynShop

Create your store account at:
https://trynshop.com/

You will get access to:

  • Store dashboard
  • Product management
  • Try-on services
  • AI processing tools
  • 3D model generation
  • Product synchronization

Step 3 — Connect Your WooCommerce Store

Connect your WooCommerce website using the API credentials provided in your TrynShop dashboard.

Step 4 — Sync Your Products

Automatically sync your eyewear products including:

  • Product names
  • Product images
  • Variations
  • Frame details

Step 5 — Automatic 3D Processing by TrynShop Studio

Products are automatically processed inside TrynShop Studio.

The platform prepares:

  • Try-on-ready assets
  • Optimized frame positioning
  • AI-aligned eyewear models
  • 3D virtual try-on experiences

No advanced design or 3D knowledge required.

Step 6 — Virtual Try-On Goes Live

Once processing is complete, virtual try-on becomes available directly on WooCommerce product pages.

Customers can instantly:

  • Open live try-on
  • Try frames virtually
  • Compare styles
  • Shop with confidence

Shortcode Fallbacks

If your theme does not render the default WooCommerce hooks correctly, you can place these shortcodes manually:

  • Product page try-on button fallback:
    [specfit_product_tryon_button]

  • Product page try-on button for a specific WooCommerce product:
    [specfit_product_tryon_button product_id=”123″]

  • Category/shop page try-on block:
    [specfit_tryon_widget]

The product button shortcode renders the same Try On button flow used on WooCommerce product pages. The archive widget shortcode is intended for shop and category layouts.

REST API

For Studio-driven category mapping, product sync, image sync, and product/category listing, see:

REST-API.md
sections.installation:
1. Upload try-on-for-woocommerce.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Create your store account at https://trynshop.com/
  4. Connect your WooCommerce store using your API credentials
  5. Sync your eyewear products
  6. Wait for automatic processing by TrynShop Studio
  7. Virtual try-on will automatically appear on supported WooCommerce products
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Is there a free plan available?

Yes. The Always Free plan supports up to 50 products with 2D virtual try-on.

Does this support 3D virtual try-on?

Yes. Premium plans support advanced 3D virtual try-on experiences powered by TrynShop.

Can I use this in my physical optical store?

Yes. SpecFit supports in-store virtual try-on experiences using tablets, kiosks, and showroom displays.

Do I need to create transparent images manually?

No. Products synced through TrynShop Studio are automatically processed and optimized for virtual try-on.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. SpecFit is optimized for mobile phones, tablets, and desktop browsers.

Where is the virtual try-on technology hosted?

All AI processing, product rendering, synchronization, and virtual try-on services are powered by TrynShop cloud technology.

More details:
https://trynshop.com/
